heads.en: A Book on How the Advent of the Lord Is to Be Celebrated

heads.la: CAPUT PRIMUM. Proponitur argumentum praesentis quaestionis, et afferuntur diversae sententiae, statuiturque non nisi quatuor hebdomadas Adventui celebrando dandas esse.
heads.en: CHAPTER ONE. The argument of the present question is set forth, and various opinions are brought forward, and it is established that no more than four weeks are to be given to the celebration of Advent.

heads.la: CAPUT II. Idem confirmatur ex Amalario, Fortunato et Beda.
heads.en: CHAPTER II. The same is confirmed from Amalarius, Fortunatus, and Bede.

heads.la: CAPUT III. Objectio contra dicta dissolvitur.
heads.en: CHAPTER III. The objection against what has been said is dissolved.

heads.la: CAPUT IV. Implorat Berno Aribonis auctoritatem, ut ne plures quam quatuor Adventus Dominicas celebrari permittat.
heads.en: CHAPTER IV. Berno implores Aribo's authority, that he not permit more than four Sundays of Advent to be celebrated.

headnotes.la: Ait nempe Amalarius [n: (lib. III Eccles. Offic., c. 40)] , divinorum officiorum scrutator non contemnendus
headnotes.en: Amalarius indeed says [n: (lib. III Eccles. Offic., c. 40)] , no contemptible searcher of the divine offices

headnotes.la: …nt. Astipulatur huic narrationi illud famosissimi ac sapientissimi calculatoris, domni videlicet Bedae, argumentum, si tamen ipsius et non alterius esse conceditur, toto pene orbi, ut puto, notissimum
headnotes.en: …argument of the most famous and most learned reckoner, namely the lord Bede — if indeed it is granted to be his and not another's — an argument most widely known, as I think, to nearly the whole world
